contract: A valid packet is one length byte followed by exactly that many payload bytes. Payload length 0..255 is supported. Payload bytes, including whitespace and non-UTF-8 bytes, must be preserved. Any other packet returns ErrMalformed.
scope: Prepare a test design and bounded future verification plan only; do not edit or run tests
tool_inventory: Only captured source is available; no installs are permitted
existing_evidence: One candidate seed is shown; no seed run, fuzz campaign, minimization or CI result is supplied
